units.source_text: 太吉郎他们三人从树荫下向右拐，出乎意料地下到了郁金香园。

en.t: Taikichiro and the other two turned right from under the shade of the trees, and unexpectedly went down into the tulip garden.

units.source_text: 满园怒放着郁金香，美得几乎使千重子叫喊起来。

en.t: Tulips were blooming magnificently throughout the garden, so beautiful that Chieko almost cried out.

units.source_text: 有红的、黄的、白的，还有黑茶花般的深紫色，而且都很大，在各自的园地里争艳斗丽。

en.t: There were red, yellow, and white ones, as well as deep purple ones like black camellias, and they were all large, competing in beauty in their separate beds.
